title: Idempotent knowledge ingestion → v0.1.40
note: branch lane/idempotent-knowledge-ingestion off main 3f6941b (worker a5198a3d). Root-caused live on Omar's own v0.1.39 backend logs: he's now installed and the v0.1.37 DB-lock crash is GONE, and he found + used the new full-history toggle (sync reached 242/250) — but full-history exposed a NEW, different crash. The full-history re-walk re-visits already-ingested messages, and the knowledge-graph ingestion does a plain INSERT into knowledge_ingestion_checkpoints (source, external_id, ...) → UNIQUE constraint failed (IntegrityError) on the already-seen message → PendingRollbackError → crashes the whole full sync ("internal error during full sync" again, different cause than v0.1.38's). Compounded: the error-handler (_record_channel_failure → _channel_label) then lazy-loads on the now-poisoned session → another PendingRollbackError. v0.1.38's guarded_write holds for locks but doesn't catch IntegrityError. Fixing: idempotent checkpoint write (SQLite UPSERT on source+external_id — re-ingest = no-op/update; audit other natural-key inserts for the same class of bug), session-rollback-on-flush-error, degrade-per-item instead of crashing the run, harden the failure-recording path so it never lazy-loads on a poisoned session. Fake-server tests + full-parallelism-green-twice. IMMEDIATE MITIGATION already applied: Mattermost full-history was turned back OFF via the app API (it was crash-looping, 21 consecutive backoffs) — re-enable after v0.1.40 lands. Building + will ship as v0.1.40 (briefed on the pnpm --filter @cadre/desktop exec tauri build --target gotcha from v0.1.39).

title: DB write-lock comprehensive fix — v0.1.38 — SHIPPED
note: main 05cdd13, both installers. Root cause was TWO things: (1) only sync workers took the write-lock, so Mattermost sync + knowledge ingestion + the understanding worker + its lease heartbeat all collided at the SQLite driver level → exhausted busy_timeout → an unhandled "database is locked" crashed the full sync (this was Omar's "internal error" AND why retries never fired — the run died before the retry sweep could run); (2) the pre-existing flaky test cluster was ALSO a test-isolation bug — tests never overrode CADRE_MODEL_MANAGER_URL, so they read Omar's REAL paused model-manager, the understanding worker deferred every job, and wait_until_idle timed out. Fixed: a re-entrant sync_write_lock + guarded_write() that RETRIES the whole write unit on database-locked (backoff, rollback-between, sleep outside the lock); routed Mattermost sync + knowledge_entities ingestion + understanding + lease-heartbeat + email writes through it; fixed a deadlock (a write transaction crossing a lock window); database-locked now degrades-per-item, never crashes a run. New flood test passes. Backend 912/0 SERIAL + 912/0 at -n auto (8 workers, all cores) TWICE — baseline was 22 failed — + model-manager 225 + frontend 99. Packaged-exe smoke verified /health=0.1.38 + WAL. Mattermost full-history toggle is now safe to re-enable on this build. Superseded by v0.1.39 (Latest) above, which is cumulative (includes this fix) and also surfaces the toggle prominently.

title: MM sync completeness + retry + logging — v0.1.36 — SHIPPED
note: main cb0697a, both installers. Root-caused live on Omar's running v0.1.35 app (curl'd /mattermost/sync/status + /sync-status/errors + checked the app data dir): sync ended status=done but left 93 done / 1 error / 156 PENDING of 250 channels; a stale constant next_retry_at meant failed channels never retried; a sync had hung ~21h before the reaper caught it; and there were no persisted backend logs. Fixed: real retry — root cause was deep_index_channel's error path freezing next_retry_at; added in-run retry sweep + next-pass retry + CHANNEL_MAX_RETRIES=8; backfill-to-completeness — active-first then inactive backfill so channels_done converges to channels_total; deep-index partial-resume (new nullable history_index_page column, migration-safe); persistent rotating FILE logging (%APPDATA%/com.cadre.desktop/backend/logs/cadre.log) + GET /sync-status/logs; 120s per-channel timeout; reaper threshold tightened 20min→15min. Feature tests 40/40 + model-manager 225 + frontend 99 green. Packaged-exe smoke verified /health=0.1.36 + log-file-written + /sync-status/logs ok. Directly answers Omar's 3 asks: retry failed channels, finish everything, application logs. Superseded by v0.1.37 (Latest) above — v0.1.37 adds the full-history depth toggle on top of this.

title: Mattermost sync resilience — v0.1.35 — SHIPPED
note: main 0f668ea, both installers. Core fix: a transient per-channel failure now DEGRADES that channel (mark + backoff + retry next pass) and the run CONTINUES / ends non-fatal "done", instead of flipping the whole workspace job to "error" and stopping (Omar's real run had stalled at 92/249 on this bug). Plus: retry-with-backoff 3x on transient errors (ConnectError/timeouts/429/5xx), prefer IPv4 (dodges the flaky-first IPv6 AAAA that caused the false "unreachable" reads), bounded timeouts (connect 8s / read 20s), real-outage classification (5 consecutive connection failures → stop early, else continue), and clear error messages (fixed the blank "unreachable: "). Tests: backend 896 + model-manager 225 + frontend 99 all green (single-threaded); +9 new tests including fake-server transient-failure injection; fixed an old buggy assertion (job.status error→done). Packaged-exe smoke verified /health=0.1.35 + /sync-status=200. No classifier blocks. Superseded by v0.1.36 above — the sync reached "done" reliably after this, but Omar found "done" still wasn't "complete" (many channels left pending, no real retry, no logs) — v0.1.36 fixes that.
